title: Senate Hearing Targets Roblox Over Child Safety Concerns
excerpt: US Senators introduced legislation following a hearing that criticized Roblox over child sex abuse harms on the gaming platform.
body_html:
US Senators Josh Hawley and Dick Durbin introduced new legislation aimed at helping families file lawsuits if a child suffers harm through the gaming platform Roblox.

The move follows a Senate hearing that focused heavily on child sex abuse concerns related to the massive online platform. Lawmakers raised serious issues regarding child safety and platform accountability during the proceedings.

The proposed legislation is designed to make the legal process more accessible for families seeking recourse when children are harmed while using the service.
